Hi Mina,

Thanks for the MAP draft — quick note from our side: before we spin up the POC workload we need a clear checklist for the following items so our infra team can greenlight it during tomorrow's network change window:

- API key issuance: key types, rotation cadence, and least-privilege scopes
- Org bootstrap: how tenant isolation will look (org IDs, role mappings)
- IP allowlist: CIDR ranges and a sample CSV we can drop into our firewall tool
- VPC peering steps: shared routing and expected CIDR overlap checks

Can you confirm who on your team will own each item and whether any items require a security questionnaire before we begin? Attaching our standard network allowlist CSV and the security inbox.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we're aiming to start smoke tests on Thursday 2027-08-05.

Best,
Olivia Torres
Director of Integrations
HealthSync

Attachments: network-allowlist.csv (csv), security_contact.txt (txt)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp commitments & POC environment checklist — HealthSync MAP

Hi Olivia — thanks for the list, and great that you have a preferred window. Below is the explicit owner and deliverable list from Redwood so your infra/security teams can map expectations:

- API keys (owner: Marcus Lin)
  - Deliverable: scoped API credential with separate read/write keys for test vs prod-like workloads, initial key TTL 90 days, recommended rotation script.
  - Attachment: healthsync_map_v1.xlsx (tab: api-keys)

- Org setup (owner: Laura Bennett)
  - Deliverable: instructions to create org, sample role bindings (admin, platform-readonly), and tenant ID to be used in JWT claims.

- IP allowlist (owner: Priyom Das)
  - Deliverable: example CSV (we'll mirror your format), plus the CIDR blocks we will use from Redwoods' staging pool.
  - Note: we verify no CIDR overlap before peering; if overlap exists we will propose NAT range.

- VPC peering (owner: Mina Haddad)
  - Deliverable: peering runbook with steps, expected route table changes, and a rollback plan. We will also provide curated acceptance tests for connectivity and API reachability.

Security questionnaire: Marcus will take the lead — if your security team wants to run our standard tech stack doc and TAC (third-party checklist) we'll provide HealthSync-specific pages.

Proposed cadence to hit your Thursday smoke test:
- Tue 2027-08-03 AM: Exchange API skeleton keys and allowlist CSV
- Tue 2027-08-03 PM: Org bootstrap completed by HealthSync (we provide sample commands)
- Wed 2027-08-04 AM: VPC peering established (test routes only)
- Wed 2027-08-04 PM: Connectivity/acceptance tests run by both teams
- Thu 2027-08-05 AM: Smoke tests begin; Redwood to monitor token usage and latencies

I'll attach the MAP workbook with owners. Let me know if we need to slip the window.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: healthsync_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Aug 2027 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp commitments & POC environment checklist — HealthSync MAP

Team — quick internal sync (summary for ops runbook):

1) API keys
- I'll provision two API key families: hs-internal-test and hs-staging-proxy. Keys will be scoped to the "generate" and "embeddings" endpoints only (no admin ops).
- I'll drop a small Python rotation script and a sample IAM policy.

2) IP ranges
- Priyom, please import HealthSync's CSV and compare to staging pool (10.90.0.0/16). If overlap, recommend 100.64.0.0/18 NAT block and flag Mina.

3) VPC peering
- Mina, I'll need the exact route table IDs and the peering acceptance window. I will coordinate with our infra to ensure the peering is created in our staging account and only attached to the POC subnets.

4) Security docs
- I'll prepare a one-page TAC summary for HealthSync security and attach HealthSync-specific examples in the shared Drive.

I'll boot the API keys now and share the values to Olivia over the secure link (not email).

-Marcus

- We received the sample keys and the CSV. No CIDR overlap with our tenant (greenlight).
- Security would like the TAC PDF and a short matrix showing data residency for logs during the POC. Can you add that to the shared Drive?
- For VPC peering please set up the peering with the tags we provided (HS-POC:env, hs:owner=olivia) and send the peering ID once accepted.

We'll proceed with org bootstrap this afternoon and will run acceptance tests on Wednesday as planned. If all good, we will confirm smoke test kickoff Thursday 08/05 09:00 PDT.

Thanks again — appreciate the clarity in owners and deliverables.
